title: Inconsistent price impact calculations
summary: _Acknowledged_  ## Severity  **Impact:** Low  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `TradingCallbacksLib::getDynamicTradePriceImpact` helps in calculating the final price impact before registering the trade. It is calculated before the `OstiumTradingCallbacks::registerTrade()` call in `OstiumTradingCallbacks::openTradeMarketCallback()` and`OstiumTradingCallbacks::executeAutomationOpenOrderCallback()`.
